name: brainbraille_visualstim
description: Visual stimuli presentation code for BrainBrialle experiments

scripts.dev: npm run add-coi && node build.js src/index.ts --bundle --sourcemap --define='window.IS_PRODUCTION=false' --servedir=src --watch --log-level=info
scripts.build: npm run add-coi && cp -r src/BrainBraille_VisualStim build/ && cp src/index.html build/ && cp src/style.css build/ && node build.js src/index.ts --bundle --sourcemap --define='window.IS_PRODUCTION=true' --outfile=build/index.js --minify --tree-shaking --log-level=silent
scripts.build-cmd-tools: esbuild --bundle cmd-tools/process_stim_seq.ts --outfile=cmd-tools-build/process_stim_seq.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22.15 --external:jsdom --external:puppeteer && tsc --lib es2022 --target es2022 --declaration cmd-tools/process_stim_seq.ts --moduleResolution node --allowSyntheticDefaultImports --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir cmd-tools-build/

author: Yuhui Zhao
